PROGRAMS IN ACTION

The Smallest Children Deserve Our Greatest Care
A warm, nurturing environment for babies beginning from 45 days, where care routines and early developmental experiences come together seamlessly.
Individual Rhythms
Our caregivers pay close attention to each baby's individual rhythms — feeding, sleep, comfort, movement, sensory experiences and interaction.
Sensory Exploration
Gentle conversation, music, touch, tummy time, movement and sensory exploration make everyday care meaningful.
Care • Comfort • Connection • Development
Little Feet. Big Curiosity.
Toddlers learn by doing. They touch, move, imitate, experiment, repeat, question and discover the world around them.
Key Developmental Focus:
The environment gives children freedom to explore while providing the security of familiar routines and caring adults.
Explore • Move • Communicate • Discover
Where Curiosity Begins To Become Learning
Nursery transforms children's natural curiosity into purposeful experiences across all domains of growth.
Foundational Skills
Through stories, conversation, play, movement, art, music and hands-on discovery, children begin developing language, early literacy, numeracy, communication, physical and social-emotional skills.
Connected Learning
Rather than separating learning into isolated subjects, experiences are connected so children begin to understand relationships between ideas.
Ask • Explore • Connect • Create
Stories are at the heart of My School ITALY. Our original books and learning materials take children into worlds of animals, nature, people, places and discovery.
A story can lead into:
Language → Mathematics → Science → Social Understanding → Creativity → Movement → Values
Our learning journey follows a simple rhythm:
LISTEN → WATCH → CONNECT → PRACTISE → MOVE & CREATE → PERFORM
Exploring The World To Making Connections
As children's language, attention and independence develop, K1 introduces increasingly structured learning while preserving the joy of discovery.
Core Pillars of K1:
Learning becomes meaningful when children can connect it.
Ready For School. Ready To Think.
K2 builds confidence and independence as children prepare for the next stage of formal schooling.
Academic Readiness
Children strengthen reading readiness, writing, mathematical thinking, scientific curiosity, communication, problem-solving and independent learning habits.
Enthusiastic Learners
Our objective is not simply to prepare children for the next classroom. It is to help them become curious thinkers, confident communicators and enthusiastic learners.
Ready for School • Ready for Learning • Ready for What Comes Next
Your Child's Day Continues With Purpose
Daycare at MSI is more than supervision after school. Children remain within a familiar environment where care, relationships, play, meals, rest, movement, learning and friendships continue naturally.
Integrated Daycare Rhythm:
You focus on your work. We remain focused on your child.
Strong Bodies Support Growing Minds
Gymnastics gives children opportunities to develop balance, coordination, flexibility, strength, spatial awareness and body confidence.
Through age-appropriate movement experiences, children learn to control their bodies, follow sequences, attempt challenges and experience the satisfaction of mastering a new movement.
Move • Balance • Persist • Achieve
From “How Does It Work?” to “Can I Make It Work?”
Our age-appropriate robotics experiences introduce children to early STEAM thinking, sequencing, patterns, cause and effect, construction and problem-solving.
STEAM Learning Foundations:
“What happens if I try this?”
Let the Body Become Another Language
Through music, rhythm, dance and creative movement, children develop coordination, body awareness, rhythm, expression, confidence and social participation.
Sometimes children communicate best not through words — but through movement.
Imagine It. Tell It. Create It.
Stories, drama, drawing, painting, music, puppetry and creative expression give children opportunities to transform imagination into something they can share.
Because creativity isn't an extra subject. It is another way of thinking.
Working days don't always fit neatly around school hours. Our Extended Daycare provides families with additional childcare beyond regular program timings.
Meetings run late. Travel gets delayed. Emergencies happen. Where available, MSI's Emergency Extended Care gives enrolled families additional support when unexpected circumstances arise.
Childcare Beyond Conventional Working Hours
Some professions don't operate from nine to five. At selected locations, MSI can provide extended childcare solutions designed for parents working night shifts, rotating schedules, healthcare, technology, emergency services and non-traditional hours.
Because modern families need modern childcare.
Because Your Working Calendar and the School Calendar Don't Always Match
Selected centres provide childcare on Saturdays and designated holidays. Children spend their day in a familiar environment with opportunities for play, creativity, movement, stories, rest and social interaction.
Consistent Care When You Need It Most
Holidays Become Adventures
Our holiday and summer programs transform school breaks into opportunities for exploration.

Ciao Baby
Observations that can provide a remarkable insight into the needs, abilities, and sensitivities of your new baby.
Birth to 3 Months
Renowned, dedicated, and passionate, Dr Aperna Volluru, has written and developed a new add-on feature to the already successful My School ITALY Kindergarten –
, designed specifically for parents and their new babies.
Our Ciao Baby programs are delivered by expertly trained Practitioners across the country. We would love to welcome you to our classes or answer any questions you may have. Please don't hesitate to contact us to see how you can take part in one or more of our unique Ciao Baby programs.
Ciao Baby Programs
Our Ciao Baby programs can truly transform those first few months for you and your baby. Have a look at our three Ciao Baby programs below:
An extraordinary opportunity for parents, our Ciao Baby programs help you to:
Benefits of our Ciao Baby Programs
Ask questions from the experts giving you boosted confidence in your abilities.
What Parents Say
Hear from parents who have experienced the Ciao Baby programs.
Ciao Baby Observation
This is 30 to 40 minutes of time spent on observation of your baby. We will provide you with an insight into what your baby can do or finds stressful, how your baby communicates with you, how your baby self-soothes, and how to provide comfort.
Crying, Colic and Comfort
3 Workshops that last around 1 hour each. Discover the 5 main cries your baby uses to communicate with you, explore the causes of colic and how to reduce or manage the symptoms, and discover comfort techniques that effectively restore balance.
Ciao Baby Massage
This is a one-hour session that includes: Baby Massage, Baby Yoga, Baby Reflexology, Sensory Integration, Containment and Comfort, Fun, Games, and Play, Bonding Experiences.

SONG & RHYMES

You Take Care of Your People. We Help Take Care of Their Little People.
For working parents, childcare is not simply a family issue. It can directly influence
return to work
employee retention
, and complete peace of mind.
Tailored Workplace Solutions
Professionally Managed Solutions:
Crèche, daycare, and extended childcare tailored for today's corporate realities.
Flexible Campus Models:
From on-site corporate crèches to reserved seats across multiple MSI centers.
Aligned Patterns:
Custom models crafted around your organization's work shifts and policy goals.
Our Promise To Your Workforce
You Take Care of Your People.
We Help Take Care of Their Little People.
One Organisation. Different Employees. Different Childcare Needs.
A single childcare model may not work for every workplace. The requirement depends on employee numbers, location, shifts, available space, commuting patterns and the ages of employees' children.
MSI Delivery Models
On-Campus Crèche:
Childcare within or adjacent to the corporate campus.
Near-Campus Preferred Centres:
Access to an MSI centre conveniently located near the workplace.
Corporate Subsidy Programs:
Employer-supported childcare with preferential arrangements for eligible employees.
Reserved Seats:
A defined number of childcare places reserved for the organisation's employees.
Extended-Hours Childcare:
Additional support for longer or non-standard working schedules.
Multi-Location Solutions:
Childcare access across multiple locations for distributed workforces.
One Childcare Partner.
Multiple Ways to Deliver.
Childcare Where Your Employees Work.
MSI can work with organisations to establish and operate childcare facilities within corporate campuses or designated workplace premises.
Depending on the engagement, MSI can support areas including:
Space Planning & Childcare Layout
Program Design
Centre Operations
Caregiver & Teacher Training
Learning Programs
Safety Procedures
Daily Operations
Meals & Nutrition
Parent Communication
Developmental Experiences
Quality Monitoring
The result is a childcare environment that gives parents the reassurance of having their child close to their workplace while the organisation benefits from a professionally managed childcare partner.
Closer to Work.
Closer to Their Child.
Corporate Childcare Without Building a Crèche.
Not every organisation needs — or has the space for — an on-campus childcare centre. Employees can instead receive preferred access to an MSI centre located conveniently near their workplace.
Depending on the agreement, this can include:
Priority Access
Preferential Corporate Fees
Reserved Capacity
Preschool + Daycare
Extended Care
Parent Connectivity

You Don't Have to Build the Childcare Infrastructure.

HITEX Campus Offerings
Programs Designed Around Your Child’s Day
At My School ITALY HITEX, learning and care come together under one roof. From a baby’s first experience away from home to Kindergarten, families can choose programs that evolve with their child.
Early Years Learning
Baby Crèche (From 45 Days) • Toddler / Playgroup • Nursery • K1 (Junior KG) • K2 (Senior KG)
Nurturing curiosity, motor development, sensory discovery and social confidence in safe, age-appropriate spaces.
Care & Extended Support
Full Daycare • Extended Daycare • Early Drop-Off • Late Pick-Up • Saturday & Holiday Care
Designed around working parents' schedules, providing continuous warmth, healthy meals, and restful care.
Beyond the Classroom
Gymnastics • Neurobics • Robotics • Dance • Storytelling • Creative Arts • Summer Camps
Expanding creative expression, physical agility, and cognitive curiosity through expert-guided activities.
“The result is continuity — one familiar environment for learning, care, development and enrichment.”
Why Families Choose MSI HITEX
Every Child Deserves To Be Known Before They Are Taught
No two children arrive with the same temperament, confidence, curiosity, interests or way of learning. At MSI HITEX, we begin by observing and understanding the child — not by expecting every child to fit the same mould.
Our Core Foundations:
We Don't Only Ask: “What Did Your Child Learn Today?”
We also ask:
What interested them?
What challenged them?
What made them participate?
And how are they growing?
“Because understanding the child changes how we teach the child.”
The NeuroPi Way™
WE DON'T BEGIN WITH THE LESSON. WE BEGIN WITH THE CHILD.
Traditional teaching often begins by asking: “What should we teach today?” The NeuroPi Way begins one step earlier: “Who is the child we are teaching?”
5-Step Observational Cycle
01. OBSERVE:
How the child approaches experiences & captured attention.
02. UNDERSTAND:
Identifying curiosity, emotional responses, persistence & communication.
03. PERSONALISE:
Designing thoughtful next steps tailored to individual readiness.
Interactive, story-led learning activities that naturally motivate.
Documenting developmental milestones and sharing progress with parents.
At MSI HITEX, teachers observe how a child approaches an experience. What captures their attention? What makes them curious? How do they communicate? What happens when something becomes difficult? When do they persist, withdraw, ask for help or try another way? These observations help teachers make thoughtful decisions about what should happen next.
“Because when we understand the child better, we can teach the child better.”
Parent Partnership
PARENTS: YOU ARE NOT DROPPING YOUR CHILD AT SCHOOL. YOU ARE JOINING THEIR JOURNEY.
Starting preschool or daycare is a milestone for the whole family. At MSI HITEX, we want you to know more than what your child “did” today — we want you to understand how they are settling in, participating, eating, resting, making friends, exploring, communicating and growing.
Our Alignment
Because the people who understand a young child best should never feel like two separate teams.
“YOU KNOW YOUR CHILD. WE GET TO KNOW YOUR CHILD TOO. TOGETHER, WE SUPPORT THE JOURNEY.”
HITEX – HiTech City Corridor
CORPORATE CHILDCARE: WHEN CHILDCARE IS CLOSER, THE WORKING DAY CAN FEEL DIFFERENT.
For a working parent, distance is not measured only in kilometres. It is measured in the time between an office and a child. MSI HITEX gives companies in and around the HITEX–HiTech City corridor an opportunity to connect employees with professional childcare closer to where they work.

The Square Campus — One Place As Your Child Grows
FROM FIRST SEPARATIONS TO FIRST INDEPENDENCE
A child’s needs at six months are very different from their needs at five years. Our programs are designed to grow with them.
Early Years Journey
Baby Crèche → Toddler / Playgroup → Nursery → K1 → K2
Care Beyond The School Day
And when the school day ends, care does not necessarily have to. Daycare, Extended Care, Early Drop-Off, Late Pick-Up, Saturday and Holiday Care give families flexibility, while Gymnastics, Neurobics, Robotics, Dance, Storytelling and Creative Arts add new dimensions to the child’s day.
“At MSI The Square, children don’t have to keep changing environments as they grow.”
Development, Not Just Academics.
WHY FAMILIES CHOOSE
MSI THE SQUARE?
BECAUSE THE MOST IMPORTANT THINGS A YOUNG CHILD IS LEARNING MAY NOT FIT ON A WORKSHEET.
Confidence. Curiosity. Communication. Independence. Resilience. Friendship. Emotional security.
These matter too.
At MSI The Square, academics form part of a much bigger developmental picture. Our children encounter language, mathematics, science and the world around them through stories, conversations, play, movement, exploration and carefully designed experiences.
“Early education should develop the learner — not simply complete the lesson.”
Observe Before You Assume
THE NEUROPI WAY™ — MSI's Neuroscience-Informed Early Childhood Pedagogy
BEFORE WE LABEL A BEHAVIOUR, WE TRY TO UNDERSTAND IT.
We observe to understand.
We understand to respond.
We respond to help the child grow.
That is NeuroPi in practice.
The NeuroPi Way™ is My School ITALY's neuroscience-informed early childhood pedagogy that helps educators understand the child behind the learning — observing how each child engages and develops, and using that understanding to personalise what happens next.
Beyond “What Did You Learn Today?”
THERE ARE BETTER QUESTIONS THAN “WHAT DID YOU LEARN TODAY?”
At MSI The Square, conversations about progress can extend beyond letters, numbers and worksheets. We may talk with you about your child's communication, curiosity, engagement, confidence, independence, relationships and approach to challenge.
Because childhood development is much richer than a checklist of academic achievements. We want parents to understand not only what their child knows — but who their child is becoming.
“YOU KNOW YOUR CHILD. WE GET TO KNOW YOUR CHILD TOO. TOGETHER, WE SUPPORT THE JOURNEY.”
A Benefit Employees Can Actually Use.
THE BEST EMPLOYEE BENEFITS SOLVE REAL-LIFE PROBLEMS.
Childcare is one of them. A working parent does not simply need a crèche listed in an employee-benefits document. They need somewhere they can genuinely trust with their child.
MSI The Square Practical Corporate Models:
Corporate Subsidy • Reserved Seats • Preferred Access • Extended Hours • Near-Workplace Childcare
• Employees gain access to an established early-years environment.
• HR teams gain a structured childcare partner.
• And the organisation turns a policy into something a parent can actually use.
“Because a benefit becomes meaningful when it works in real life.”
A child who doesn't immediately join an activity may need more time to observe.
A child who repeatedly asks questions may be exploring deeply.
A child who moves constantly may engage more readily through movement.
A child who struggles with one experience may flourish when it is presented differently.
What made you laugh?
What made you curious?
Who did you play with?
What was difficult?
What did you try by yourself?
What would you like to do again tomorrow?
